deviations.reason: guard-destructive-git.sh blocked git checkout -- (destructive git command hook). Ran bash .claude/scripts/git-snapshot.sh (stash-based snapshot) instead per the hook's own suggested remediation, then precisely removed the single appended test line via Edit tool and confirmed with git diff (empty). Note: the git-snapshot.sh stash operation is repo-wide (not path-scoped) and briefly stashed concurrent uncommitted work from another active agent in this shared session on .claude/scripts/manage-topics.sh, which surfaced as a transient, unrelated FAIL in the verification re-run; git stash pop immediately restored that agent's work and the transient FAIL disappeared. No production code or check logic was altered because of this.
